references.label: Top saucer
references.description: The center kickout scores 3,000, advances bonus three units, and builds Bonus X toward 5x.
references.context: Plunge or lob the ball into the top-center saucer.

references.label: A-B lanes and orbits
references.description: Top lanes and both long orbits collect A and B and advance the lit A-B award.
references.context: Use the A-B lanes and orbits to advance base bonus.

references.label: Eight drop targets
references.description: The symmetric banks total eight targets and score 50,000 when completed.
references.context: Finish the drop bank only from safe rebounds.

references.label: Left 50,000 outlane
references.description: The second saucer collect lights the left outlane for 50,000.
references.context: The second saucer collect lights the left outlane.

references.label: Right 50,000 outlane
references.description: The third saucer collect lights the right outlane for 50,000.
references.context: The third saucer collect lights the right outlane.
